name: Pricing card
summary: A plan card with name, price, description, feature list and a call to action, used on .v-card.
description: Put two to four cards in a grid. The feature list grows, so the buttons line up across a row. Mark one plan with .v-pricing-featured and a badge, not several.

classes.name: v-pricing
classes.description: Goes with .v-card on an <article>: sets the gap between the parts.

classes.name: v-pricing-featured
classes.description: The recommended plan: an accent ring and a stronger shadow.

classes.name: v-pricing-header
classes.description: Plan name and an optional badge in a row.

classes.name: v-pricing-name
classes.description: The plan name, in display type.

classes.name: v-pricing-price
classes.description: Amount and period on one baseline.

classes.name: v-pricing-amount
classes.description: The price, large with tabular figures.

classes.name: v-pricing-period
classes.description: What the price covers: per month, forever.

classes.name: v-pricing-desc
classes.description: One line on who the plan is for.

classes.name: v-pricing-features
classes.description: The feature <ul>. Icons in the items take the accent colour.

a11y: Use a heading for the plan name, so people can jump between plans by heading.
Write the period as words ("per month") next to the amount, so the price reads as a whole.
The featured plan is marked by its badge text, not only by the accent ring.
Name each button for its plan ("Choose Pro") rather than repeating "Buy".

examples.title: Three plans
examples.description: The middle plan is featured. The last card uses .v-card-feature, the filled card variant.
